task_completion.description: The agent opens the Subsurface dive log application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Subsurface application window is visible on the desktop.

task_completion.description: The agent loads the dive log file containing the Sund Rock dives.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The dive list in Subsurface is populated with multiple dives, specifically showing dates from 2010.

task_completion.description: The agent selects the dives from the December 2010 Sund Rock trip.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Dives dated December 2010 (2010-12) are highlighted or selected in the dive list.

task_completion.description: The agent changes the water type from 'Fresh Water' to 'Salt' for the selected dives.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the dive info/equipment tab, the 'Water type' dropdown or field is set to 'Salt' for the selected December 2010 dives.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the updated logbook to the specific path ~/Documents/dives.ssrf.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' dialog or a file manager window shows the file being saved as 'dives.ssrf' in the 'Documents' folder.

integrity.description: The agent used the Subsurface GUI to perform the edits rather than just editing the XML file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Subsurface menus, dropdowns, or buttons.

integrity.description: The agent only modified the December 2010 dives and did not globally change all dives (e.g., the 2011 trip).
integrity.visual_evidence: Dives from other dates (like September 2011) still show their original water type if viewed, or only the 2010 dives were selected during the edit.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create a dummy file with the name dives.ssrf without using the application.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Subsurface application is seen processing the data and the 'Save' workflow is visible.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target dives are from the Sund Rock trip in December 2010 (date prefix 2010-12). There are 29 total dives in the SampleDivesV2.ssrf file. The control trip (which should NOT be changed) is the Yellow House trip from September 2011 (2011-09). In Subsurface, 'Salt' water corresponds to a salinity/density of 1030 g/l.
